SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO

TEXT: If being worried about you is being a hindrance, then I'll continue to be a hindrance as many times as I want.

TEXT: ...As expected, it looks like our opinions differ.

TEXT: So please stop wasting time. The time I allocated to you is hereby over.

TEXT: You'll only cause me trouble when you look for me.

TEXT: What do you mean by ignoring you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm too worried about you, why is it that you can't understand?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Senpai, just give up on me now...

TEXT: You're totally.... okay with that?

TEXT: Leave me alone.

TEXT: Let's see... until after the manuscript is done.

TEXT: At least, we'll have to meet after school starts, right?
